title: email templates: after a source edit and hot reload, the by-name read serves the new template while the list read and every send keep the old copy until a cold restart
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSwDXZrZg7nGjP6P3U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a reproduction, found by QA run #27438 (wave 3 of the 18.3.0 sweep, anchor #27377). Reproduced 3 times. reach: measured at public doors. `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template` serves stale content, and a flow-driven send writes a `sys_email` row with the stale subject.
Business reason: on the dev loop (`os dev`, watcher on), a developer edits a declared email template, sees the by-name read already serving the new copy, and believes the change is live. Recipients keep getting the old wording until a cold restart. The two reads of one template also disagree with each other.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the implementer for the email template loader (`packages/plugins/plugin-email`) and the artifact hot-reload path.
Dedupe (open AND closed): the query "email template hot reload stale list send old subject artifact reload" returned 2 hits, neither the same:
- #7733 (closed): a runtime `PUT /meta` write never materialised without a restart;
- #21785 (closed): an overlay reverted on boot.

At c4c515ad, admin overlay saves through `PUT /meta` do reach sends immediately. This card is the source-edit plus hot-reload path.

Batch-of: 16 · QA run #27438

## Symptom

After a source edit and hot reload, a declared email template serves the new copy only on the by-name read. The list read and real sends keep the old copy until a cold restart.

## Reproduction (subject c4c515ad)

1. Copy `examples/app-showcase` to a scratch directory and boot it with `os dev` on its own port (watcher on, `OS_PORT` exported).
2. With no en-US overlay row present, edit the subject of `showcase_task_done_email` in `src/system/emails/index.ts`.
3. Run `objectstack compile` in the copy and wait for the boot log line `artifact auto-reloaded (file watcher)`.
4. `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/showcase_task_done_email` serves the **new** subject.
5. `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template` (the list) still serves the **old** subject.
6. Complete a `showcase_task` so the notify flow sends the template. The new `sys_email` row (and the `[LogTransport] would send email` line) carries the **old** subject.
7. Stop the boot and cold-start it again. The send now renders the new subject.

**Expected** (integration-system.email-template-render negative[0]): the served item and what recipients receive never disagree.

## Mechanism (read from source, not proven)

The send path's template loader reads `getMetaItemsForExecution`, which lists from the schema registry. The list read uses the same source. The artifact hot reload appears to refresh the by-name metadata item but not the schema-registry entries for `email_template`.
